newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures fall on rubber stock gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures fall on rubber stock gains.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Thursday, as selling gathered force ahead of the close in response to news that Japan's rubber stocks as of March 20 rose to 35,972 tonnes from 34,841 tonnes on March 10, traders said.
Prices ranged from 2.2 yen to 4.4 yen per kg lower. Benchmark September was down 2.2 yen at 148.6 yen.

Prices opened weaker, with bearish sentiment carried over from the previous day. "There is a perception that Japan's rubber stocks will increase further in April, following stock gains as of March 20," one trader said. "Bearish sentiment will continue to dominate the market," he said.
